data.long_meaning: From the Old English word 'coda,' meaning 'help' or 'assistance.' This name can be interpreted as 'one who provides code or knowledge.'. The name Codi carries the meaning “Code, knowledge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Codi usually hope their child will grow to embody code, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Codi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Code, knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Codi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
